verdicts.decision_note: The client explicitly instructs the freelancer to delay development of the initial logo concepts until reference material is supplied.
After the client supplies design references and preferences, the freelancer explicitly commits to developing the initial concepts, ending the deferral.
Target-specific implementation claim: the freelancer presents the initial logo drafts for review, marking the first claimed delivery of the concept set.
First concrete verification: the client evaluates at least three delivered concepts, identifies preferred options, and confirms that the concept direction is progressing successfully.
